summary: Iteration 2 focused on the three follow-up items (theme toggle, iframe sandbox fix, site settings) plus a light-theme regression. All 21 backend pytest cases pass (18 pre-existing + 3 new TestSiteSettings). Frontend Playwright verified: theme toggle switches document.documentElement.dark class, changes body background rgb(5,5,6) <-> rgb(245,247,249), persists in localStorage and survives reload. Embed iframe has NO sandbox attribute, referrerPolicy='strict-origin-when-cross-origin', allow includes autoplay/encrypted-media/fullscreen/picture-in-picture, and src updates when switching host-tab (VOE <-> DoodStream). Admin Site Settings tab saves via PUT /api/admin/settings, GET /api/settings reflects change, landing sidebar/header brand updates live; settings were reset back to MirrorStream defaults. Light-theme regression: admin login -> /admin OK, /dashboard/new loads, /dashboard/stats/<id> renders 6 recharts elements with visible tooltip and no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: DEFAULT_SETTINGS is defined AFTER get_settings() references it (line 497 vs 524). Works because get_settings is called at request-time (Python late binding), but reads oddly. Consider moving DEFAULT_SETTINGS above the endpoint or importing from a config module.
SettingsContext.jsx swallows fetch errors silently (catch {}). Consider logging so misconfigured environments surface.
seed() overwrites /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every startup - intentional per playbook, previously flagged.
test_credentials: admin@mirrorstream.com / Admin@1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Site settings were mutated during test but restored to MirrorStream defaults.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_IframeCheck mirror for iframe attribute verification. TEST_UI_Movie from iteration 1 still exists (kept for demo).

Iteration 2 verifies theme (localStorage 'theme' key, .dark class on <html>), iframe fix (no sandbox, referrerPolicy strict-origin-when-cross-origin), and site settings CRUD via /api/admin/settings + public /api/settings.
